notes.title: Sir War-A-Lot is in the Fan Favorite vote at Game Development World Championship
notes.notes:
Hi All

Sir War-A-Lot is in the Fan Favorite vote at Game Development World Championship.

This is awesome!

If you enjoyed this game and would like to support it  you can go to http://thegdwc.com/ to vote.

No need to sign up or anything, simply scroll down a bit and click on the vote button to vote for Sir-War-A-Lot.

Fans can vote for the game from Monday 5 July 2021 until the following Monday 12 July 2021, 10:00 am Finnish time GMT+3

Thank you for all the support! :)

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 released
notes.notes:
Hi All

Had to release a patch on day one to fix an issue where the payer will start at the wrong location once beating a boss.
Phew, luckily that was found quickly and all should be good now.
I'm here to assist, let me know if anyone has any other problems

Thank you to all the gamers who came out to support my game on day one.
I appreciate it.

notes.title: Sir War-A-Lot release date set!
notes.notes:
Hi all

I am happy to share that Sir War-A-Lot is ready for release and the the date has been set for 26 March.
Everybody get ready to start throwing some swords around.
